title: FieldShift offline NASA POWER daily dataset — VTR Weaving Mills area
source: NASA POWER Daily Point API (Agroclimatology community)
methodology: NASA POWER daily point time series requested at the Google Places coordinates for VTR Weaving Mills. The API snaps the returned data to its native source grid. GPM IMERG and SMAP values are retained only when present. This historical dataset is not a forecast or field-level measurement.

location.name: VTR Weaving Mills, Vadavalli, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
